quote: The security of the RSA cryptosystem depends on the computational difficulty of factoring the product of two large primes
posed_by: Ronald L. Rivest, Adi Shamir, Leonard M. Adleman
note: The question emerged gradually from mathematical observations (Gauss 1801, Jevons 1874) and complexity theory (Cook 1971, Karp 1972). The explicit formulation as a computational complexity problem—whether integer factorization can be done in polynomial time—was first posed in its modern complexity-theoretic framework by the RSA paper (1977-1978, submitted April 1977). Garey-Johnson (1979) canonicalized it as an official open problem in computational complexity.
